profile_text.body:
Symbotic Inc. describes itself as a warehouse automation company whose systems move goods through the supply chain. According to its site, it builds complete, end-to-end warehouse automation that combines dense storage, streamlined operations, and AI-enhanced software the company says sees beyond the warehouse walls. It states that its solutions can be adapted for palletized goods, small quantity fulfillment, and omnichannel operations, and that items ranging from 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) up to 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm) can be handled in their native packaging, with options for loose items and cold chain requirements.

The company positions itself as both the software and key robotic innovator for each solution it sells, contrasting this with integrators it says are limited by their portfolio of technology partnerships. It describes itself as a leader in industrial automation and in technology at large, and says its purpose is getting the right goods to people who need them when they need them. It also refers to leading the advent of AI software that expands operational possibilities, and says its solutions are trusted by retailers and distributors.

Symbotic Inc. is a public company headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker SYM, with SEC CIK 0001837240. Its legal exposure is listed in Massachusetts, with 191 matters recorded and no individual cases named.
